title: Matthew Bible Quiz - Chapter 12
description: Ten questions on Matthew 12: grain plucked on the Sabbath, the withered hand healed, the charge about Beelzebul and the sign of Jonah.

questions.text: What did the disciples do on the Sabbath that the Pharisees objected to?
questions.explanation: The disciples were hungry and began to pluck heads of grain and to eat, and the Pharisees said this was not lawful on the Sabbath.

answers.text: They healed a man's withered hand
They ate with unwashed hands
They plucked heads of grain and ate
They worked in the fields for hire

questions.text: Whose example did Jesus bring up, of eating the show bread?
questions.explanation: Jesus asked whether they had read what David did when he was hungry, entering God's house and eating the show bread.

answers.text: David
Solomon
Jonah
Moses

questions.text: Of what did Jesus say the Son of Man is Lord?
questions.explanation: Jesus said that the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.

answers.text: The temple
The harvest
The law and the prophets
The Sabbath

questions.text: What did Jesus tell the man with the withered hand to do?
questions.explanation: He told the man to stretch out his hand, and it was restored whole, just like the other.

answers.text: Go and show himself to the priest
Stretch out his hand
Wash and come back
Say nothing to anyone

questions.text: What did the Pharisees do after the man's hand was healed?
questions.explanation: The Pharisees went out and conspired against him, how they might destroy him.

answers.text: They conspired how to destroy him
They followed him and were healed
They praised God for the healing
They brought him more sick people

questions.text: How did the Pharisees say he cast out demons?
questions.explanation: The Pharisees said he did not cast out demons except by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.

answers.text: By the Spirit of God given to him
By the wisdom of Solomon the king
By Beelzebul, the prince of the demons
By the authority of the scribes

questions.text: What did Jesus say happens to every kingdom divided against itself?
questions.explanation: He said every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation, and a divided city or house will not stand.

answers.text: It will stand forever
It is brought to desolation
It will be given to another
It will be plundered by the strong man

questions.text: Which blasphemy did Jesus say will not be forgiven?
questions.explanation: He said every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven.

answers.text: A word against the Son of Man
False vows made in the temple
Every idle word men speak
Blasphemy against the Spirit

questions.text: Which sign did Jesus say would be given to this generation?
questions.explanation: He said no sign would be given to an evil and adulterous generation but the sign of Jonah the prophet.

answers.text: The sign of Isaiah the prophet
A sign from heaven with power
The sign of Jonah the prophet
The sign of Solomon's wisdom

questions.text: Whom did Jesus call his brother, sister and mother?
questions.explanation: He said that whoever does the will of his Father who is in heaven is his brother, and sister, and mother.

answers.text: Whoever does the will of his Father
Those who stood outside seeking him
The men of Nineveh who repented
Those who heard the parables
